column1: # Where update.py reads the certificates of each service's genuine packages (ADR 0021). Columns: service,
#   embedded-certificates  the X.509 certificates that the vendor's own client library carries to check
#                          the service, except those with AOSP's test-key subject (android@android.com),
#                          which do not prove that a package is genuine;
#   embedded-fingerprints  the SHA-256 fingerprints that the vendor's own client library carries.
